retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.name: Keep multiple contexts within one owner
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.quote: If I have errands after work, I sometimes use a charger near the office.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.implementation: Sample an owner profile with all its context records. Allocate each session to one context; do not treat each context row as a different owner.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.boundary: Interview context mentions are not allocation weights. Survey total and context frequencies still need reconciliation.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.full_answer: On workdays I usually come home and connect the car. I check what I need to do the next morning, then decide whether to schedule the charging for later. If I have errands after work, I sometimes use a charger near the office.

retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.name: Use the reported charging-start window once
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.quote: I connect it when I get home, but I set the car to begin charging later.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.implementation: Use survey charging-start windows as actual start windows. Do not apply an additional automatic TOU delay to the baseline profile.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.boundary: A future tariff-change scenario would require separately stated assumptions; usual reported timing does not measure its causal effect.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.full_answer: I connect it when I get home, but I set the car to begin charging later. If I must leave early the next morning, I sometimes start immediately because I would rather pay more than risk having too little charge.

retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.name: Separate active charging from connected time
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.quote: At home the car can remain connected after it finishes, but it stops drawing power at the target.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.implementation: Accumulate demand only over active charging intervals. Keep parked or connected duration separate from electrical charging duration.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.boundary: A recalled duration is not automatically a measured active duration. Any simplified power curve must be declared separately.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.full_answer: At home the car can remain connected after it finishes, but it stops drawing power at the target. At a public station I watch the app and return around completion because someone else may need the charger.

retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.name: Respect reported home-charging access
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.quote: I cannot charge at home. I park in a shared apartment area and there is no approved charging point there.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.implementation: If survey home access is 'No, I cannot charge at home', do not create T2 sessions. Flag contradictory home-use answers for review instead of silently rewriting them.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.boundary: Limited access is not the same as no access. The interview case cannot be linked to a survey owner by its number.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.full_answer: I cannot charge at home. I park in a shared apartment area and there is no approved charging point there.

retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.name: Keep energy accounting consistent across sessions
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.quote: I charged less at home the following night.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.implementation: Account for energy across an owner's sessions. A context switch must not automatically add a second full daily energy requirement; extra travel can increase energy only through an explicit assumption or observation.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.boundary: The passage supports possible substitution, not a fixed amount or universal replacement rule. Do not add distance-derived energy to delivered energy for the same requirement.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.full_answer: Last month a relative needed a lift that evening. I used a public charger near the hospital because the planned overnight home charge would have been too late. I charged less at home the following night.

retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.name: Keep temporary disruption separate from usual behaviour
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.quote: A temporary equipment problem can make a normally home-dominant owner appear public-dominant in a short observation window.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.implementation: Retain an exceptional-period annotation when reviewing evidence. Do not overwrite usual survey behaviour solely because a short public-charging history differs.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.boundary: Do not infer an equipment failure from a mismatch alone, or automatically discard records. An exceptional-period flag requires supporting evidence.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.full_answer: A temporary equipment problem can make a normally home-dominant owner appear public-dominant in a short observation window.

retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.name: Trip urgency may change charging decisions
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.quote: If I do not know whether there will be an extra trip tomorrow, I charge earlier and aim a little higher.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.implementation: Keep this as a contextual dependency. Do not introduce random urgent-trip events or a fixed target increase in the baseline yet.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.boundary: An event rate and adjustment magnitude need observations or explicitly labelled sensitivity assumptions; 'a little higher' provides neither.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.full_answer: If I do not know whether there will be an extra trip tomorrow, I charge earlier and aim a little higher. That is different from a normal office night when I know the distance.

retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.name: Unavailable chargers may change the next action
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.quote: If I can get home comfortably, I leave; otherwise I check a second station or wait a short time.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.implementation: Retain the conditional options for later analysis. Do not invent queue durations, station failures, or switch probabilities in the baseline.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.boundary: Executing a queue or station-availability model would require further evidence or an explicitly separate sensitivity scenario.
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
retained_baseline_behaviour_constraints.full_answer: First I look at the battery and the time. If I can get home comfortably, I leave; otherwise I check a second station or wait a short time. I do not assume the next station is free.

population_contract.estimation_pool: Use parameter-specific evidence from all retained owners, with explicit denominators.
population_contract.dependencies: Owner and four context rows remain linked; no independent marginal generator is implemented.
population_contract.missing_and_open_bounds: Retain raw answers and censoring metadata; no midpoint substitution, tail cap or imputation.
population_contract.time: Circular reported start windows; within-window timing requires an explicit sampling assumption.
population_contract.categories: Counts include unknown/mixed answers and nonuse strata; they are not fitted charger probabilities.
population_contract.home_equipment: Unknown type or power detail is not automatically a contradiction.
population_contract.frequency: Completed sessions versus attempted starts must be resolved and checked against accepted sessions.
population_contract.energy: Choose one primary energy route and electrical boundary before population generation.
population_contract.tou: Reported start windows may include intentional delay; avoid applying a second shift.
population_contract.geography: Residence is metadata; no district behaviour fits, fleet shares or charging-place weights are inferred.
population_contract.sampling_unit: Respondent owner; contexts and parameters are repeated evidence, not extra independent respondents.
population_contract.future_ids: Generated virtual-owner IDs must be separate from respondent IDs.
population_contract.interviews: Retained baseline constraints are archival; numerical interview effects require evidence review.
